_comment: Agent feature pipeline config (docs/AGENT-PIPELINE.md). projects = every board the dispatcher polls (github.com/users/<owner>/projects/<number>). repos = allowlist: only Ready cards whose issue lives in one of these repos are picked up. Per-repo keys override defaults. statuses = the exact Status option names on the boards. autoMerge = merge the PR (mergeMethod) once the gate and any GitHub PR checks (waited up to checksMinutes) pass, card -> Done; false = leave it In review. checksGraceMinutes = how long 'no checks reported yet' is waited out before concluding the repo has none (0 for zca-accounting, whose CI is manual-only). manualMergePaths = path prefixes whose changes always wait In review for a human merge (e.g. terraform/, where merging applies to production).
